pie...@my-deja.com wrote:
> >Card Title: Archon
> >Card Type: Political Action
> >Card Text: Political Card-Worth 1 Vote
> > Called by any Prince or Justicar at +1 stealth.
> > Choose a vampire. Successful vote makes the vampire
> > an Archon. The Archon may enter combat with
> > another vampire as a +1 stealth action; anyone
> > attempting to block the Archon burns 1 blood
>

A base my answers on the text you cite (from the WotC spoiler list),
even though that text appears to be incomplete. I don't have an
actual card in front of me to verify, however.

> Are Archons stackable?

You may name a vampire who is already an Archon, yes.

> [Would the blood expenditure and ability to attack be cumulative?]
> or is Archon more of a status which is conferred, with multiples being
> sort of pointless.

The latter. They are not cumulative since the ability to attack and
the blood-for-blocking come from *being* an Archon (status), not
from the card (a difference between the V:TES and Jyhad printings
of the card).
